candidate_id_rule: sha256(symbol|accession|span).slice(0,16) — verified for all 682 at build time
raw_filing_text: NOT COMMITTED. Spans are represented by spanSha256 only; the filing body by documentSha256.

identity_resolution.resolved_ticker: identified as exactly one US-listed operating issuer; any residual exact-match ambiguity is share classes / preferreds of that same issuer, which an is_primary instrument flag (FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE 7.2) disambiguates
identity_resolution.resolved_private: identified entity with NO US-listed common stock — private, wholly-owned subsidiary, or foreign-listed-only. Not tradable; resolved_symbol is null
identity_resolution.ambiguous: maps to more than one distinct issuer, or to no primary US listing

relationship_type.customer_revenue: the counterparty buys goods/services from the filer; the filer books it as revenue/net sales
relationship_type.market_maker_counterparty: the counterparty pays the filer for order flow / execution. Revenue flows the same direction but the economic driver is trading volume and rebate economics, not the counterparty's demand for a product
relationship_type.tenant_rent: the counterparty leases space/sites from the filer under a multi-year contract. Revenue is contracted rent, not demand-sensitive purchasing
relationship_type.supplier: the filer buys from the counterparty (no accepted span carries this)

enum_extensions.justification: FSLR span c23c70023000c869 discloses "10% or more of our MODULES BUSINESS net sales". Recording that as net_sales would silently claim a consolidated denominator the filing does not give. Only FSLR span c23c7002 uses it.

rules.never_sum_across_relationship_types: customer_revenue, market_maker_counterparty and tenant_rent are different economic relationships and must be counted and reported separately. No headline number in the study sums across them.
rules.exposure_is_floor: true when the filing discloses a threshold ("10% or more") rather than a share. A floor is not a weight; floors cannot be sales-weighted (FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE 7.3, 14).
rules.available_at: acceptanceDateTime from the EDGAR submissions feed, never filingDate — they differ and filingDate is wrong in both directions (see study 4).
rules.fail_closed: resolved_symbol is non-null if and only if identity_resolution === "resolved_ticker". unresolved / ambiguous / resolved_private links carry a null symbol and are never counted as tradable.
rules.dedup_for_counting: relationships are deduplicated by (symbol, counterparty_name, period, relationship_type). Overlapping spans restate ONE disclosure — CHD has 6 spans for one Walmart link, SWK 3, AMT 2, CELH 3, CRWV 2, QCOM 2, FSLR 2. Span-level counts double-count and are never reported as relationship counts.
rules.dedup_basis_preference: when duplicate (symbol, counterparty, period, type) tuples disagree on exposure_basis, the consolidated denominator wins over a segment denominator (FSLR: net_sales beats segment_net_sales).

review_protocol.second_pass_full_reread: span text re-read in full by the second-pass adjudicator
review_protocol.first_pass_adopted_after_screen: first-pass rejection adopted after passing a mechanical false-negative screen (a percentage within 220 chars of a counterparty keyword AND a corporate-suffix or mega-cap proper noun in the same window). Every one of the 682 went through the screen; the screen's 31 hits, all 10 named_customer_no_share, all 3 supplier_or_vendor_not_customer, and a deterministic stride sample of the large buckets were re-read in full.
review_protocol.unproven: RECALL OF THE REGEX NETS THEMSELVES IS UNPROVEN. This manifest adjudicates the 682 spans the nets emitted. It cannot rule out a named-and-weighted disclosure in a filing region no net matched, because the raw filing text is deliberately not committed. Bounding that would require re-running the probe with a widened net and diffing.
